transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in, or what's been troubling you lately?

Well, what scared me enough to actually come in today is... I just keep thinking that it would be a relief if I didn't wake up. I haven't tried to hurt myself or do anything like that, but just having those kinds of thoughts is what brought me here.
How long have you been having these thoughts and feelings of wanting to not wake up?
I'd say it's been going on for about four months now. It started right around the time my aunt came to live with us.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, when you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I can't say that I have. I've never really had a time where I felt super energetic or like I didn't need to sleep. Honestly, it's mostly just been the opposite of that.
Over the past four months, have you been drinking alcohol or using any substances more than usual?
No, I haven't. I don't really drink... I never have been much of a drinker, to be honest. And I don't use any drugs or anything like that. So, no, nothing like that going on.
Over these past four months, have you noticed that you feel sad, down, or empty, or have lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, I'd say that's true. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest... it's like I've already failed the day before it even starts. And I just don't care about much of anything anymore.
Have you experienced anything like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't seem to notice, or having thoughts or beliefs that others have told you seem unusual or not true?

Yes, I have. Um... sometimes when the house gets quiet, mostly after I get my aunt put to bed, I hear my mother's voice. It's clear as day. She tells me I'm selfish, or that I'm not doing enough. And... well, I know she's been gone for years now, but I still hear her saying it to me.
Do you hear your mother's voice only during times when you're feeling really down and hopeless, or does it happen even when your mood feels more normal or okay?

It's only when I'm feeling really down. I never heard my mother's voice, or... or felt watched by her before I sank into this sadness. That all started after my aunt moved in. So, no, it doesn't happen if I'm having an okay day. It really just happens on the bad, heavy days, when I feel like I've failed everyone.

Before these last four months, have you ever had another period in your life—lasting two weeks or more—where you felt similarly depressed, lost interest in things, or had low energy, separate from how you're feeling now?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had sad days before, like anyone else, but nothing like this. Nothing that lasted for weeks on end where I just couldn't shake it. This is the first time it's been this bad.
